BETA Close X Bellway PLC has executed a share buyback program, purchasing a total of 274,668 ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange between April 27, 2026, and May 1, 2026. The volume-weighted average price for these purchases was 1,908.16 pence per share, with prices ranging from 1,855.00 pence to 1,980.00 pence. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of ordinary shares in issue to 115,418,367. This buyback is part of the company's ongoing share repurchase program announced in October 2025 and April 2026. Disclaimer* Bellway PLC 05 May 2026 Bellway p.l.c. Transaction in Own Shares 5 May 2026 Bellway p.l.c. ('Bellway' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of the share buyback programme (the 'Buyback Programme') announced on 14 October 2025 and the terms of the Second Tranche announced on 2 April 2026, from 27 April 2026 up to and including 1 May 2026 the Group purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 12.5 pence each (the Ordinary Shares') through Deutsche Bank AG. Date Number of shares purchased Highest price paid (GBp) Lowest price paid (GBp) Volume weighted average price (GBp) Trading venue 27 April 2026 51,000 1,980.00 1,940.00 1,952.53 XLON 28 April 2026 52,000 1,936.00 1,898.00 1,915.89 XLON 29 April 2026 66,000 1,911.00 1,857.00 1,886.64 XLON 30 April 2026 60,000 1,900.00 1,855.00 1,884.20 XLON 1 May 2026 45,668 1,920.00 1,905.00 1,912.40 XLON The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Since the announcement of the Second Tranche of the Buyback Programme on 2 April 2026, Bellway has purchased 915,947 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation. Bellway has now purchased 3,874,263 Ordinary Shares under the first and second tranche (to date) in aggregate for cancellation under the Buyback Programme. Following settlement of the above purchases and cancellation of the purchased ordinary shares, the Group's total number of ordinary shares in issue shall be 115,418,367 ordinary shares. In accordance with Article 5(1)(b) of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 as it applies in the UK (the Market Abuse Regulation), the table below contains detailed information of the individual trades made by Deutsche Bank AG on behalf of Bellway as part of the Buyback Programme.
